title: Services and Facades
readerIntent: Understand where reusable behavior and use-case coordination belong.
owner: Each capability owns its domain services; shared mechanics belong to Nodics service contracts
summary: Services perform reusable domain behavior; facades coordinate a use case across services; controllers remain transport adapters.

sections.heading: Business value
items: Keep one behavior reusable from APIs, jobs, events, workflows, imports, and assistants.
Override customer-specific behavior through later modules without copying callers.
Coordinate multi-service use cases without turning controllers into business owners.
Use one governed module-communication client with resilience and safe diagnostics.

sections.heading: Decision rule
items: Use a service for cohesive reusable behavior.
Use a facade when a use case coordinates several services or response concerns.
Keep domain ownership in the owning module even when a facade coordinates other modules.
Do not add a facade that only renames one service call.
